# First Officer by UpNonStop

> First Officer is a rewards desk for business card spend: one conversation with First Officer across every loyalty program on the owner's file, working for the business owner. One flat plan at $550 a month. Award bookings are a separate $500 per itinerary. The Found Money Call is free and takes 20 minutes. US businesses only.

Plain facts, as stated on the site:

- Every connection is read-only. Nothing moves without the owner's yes; every transfer or booking waits for approval.
- Every Friday the owner gets a report with the dollar value of what was captured that week, est.
- No affiliate money from any bank, airline or hotel program, ever.
- No guaranteed savings. Every figure shown is an estimate, labeled est. Award space is set by each program and is not guaranteed.
- Not financial, tax or legal advice. The desk does not replace an accountant or financial advisor.
- UpNonStop, 235 Pavonia Avenue, Jersey City, NJ 07302. WhatsApp +1 619 940 4040.

- [Enterprise Rewards Desk: Every Team, Every Card](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/enterprise.html): For companies with many cardholders, several departments or several entities: one desk across every card, read-only, one number in dollars every Friday, priced for your setup. Talk to our team.
- [Found Money Calculator for Business Card Spend](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/calculator.html): One slider for your monthly business card spend: what the desk could find, est., and whether it pays for itself. Go advanced to set your trade and spend line by line.
- [Read-Only Access: What We See and Never Touch](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/trust.html): Read-only connections, your approval first, no affiliate money and what we do not claim.
- [Why First Officer: A Rewards Desk on Your Side](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/about.html): Why First Officer exists, the rules we work by and the four pillars: Earn, Burn, Return, Learn.
- [Free Found Money Call: 20-Minute Rewards Review](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/book.html): 20 minutes on Google Meet, free. See what your business card spend could be earning, in dollars.
- [Free Card Rewards Guides for Business Owners](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/freebies.html): Everything I'd tell you over coffee: the codes, the questions and the notes we keep for each trade. Free to read. Leave your email for the new ones.
- [Business Card Rewards by Industry](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/industries.html): Your trade, your codes: 20 industries, each with an example monthly mix, the codes your vendors usually run under, and a calculator preset.

- [The Intelligence Report: Weekly Rewards Briefing](https://firstofficer.upnonstop.com/upns.html): The Intelligence Report, every Saturday: transfer bonuses worth acting on, quiet repricings and one save from a wallet like yours.
